[POL-TPS §1] Purpose: This policy sets the conditions under which Harbourline information may be shared with third parties such as vendors, partners and service providers.
query: Can a vendor receive customer data before its security assessment?
response: A vendor cannot receive customer data before passing a Vendor Security Assessment. [POL-TPS §3.1] Sharing confidential customer information with a third party requires data owner approval after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed. [POL-TPS §4.1]
